dog.description_text:
Allow us to introduce you to the sweet Stella Mae! This adorable 2-year-old, 34-pound retriever mix is loving, affectionate, and ready to find her forever home. Stella Mae does wonderfully with dogs, cats, and kids, making her a great addition to all kinds of families. She loves being around people and is the kind of pup who forms strong bonds with those closest to her.

Whether she’s tagging along for an adventure, curling up for some downtime, or simply spending time with her favorite people, Stella Mae is happy just being by your side. She has a sweet, gentle nature and is ready for a home where she can get plenty of love and become a true member of the family.

Registered adopters interested in Stella Mae can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
